json.task: I need to sign up for RASPIRE and quickly get a handle on the attack surface for three of our key applications. I'll define these assets, initiate their scans, and review the initial findings. Then, I want to set up a custom dashboard to track critical vulnerabilities across these apps and apply a filter to focus on high-severity issues. Finally, I'll update the status of a few identified vulnerabilities and generate a report for my team.
json.core_job: Identify, analyze, and manage application attack surface.
